projectWorktrees.scope: Real Git repositories/worktrees/hooks and native main/Quick bridges, Monaco, atomic project-save EIO and restart; fixed display scale and scripted input. Worktree deletion/pruning, managed roots, task orchestration, broader accessibility and complete reference parity remain separate gates.

mcpPdf.scope: Real stdio PDF resources and binary-only prompt, actual import/PDF renderer workers, corrupt-file recovery, delayed worker/subscription invalidation, local ownership, exact export, light/dark minimum-window zoom and keyboard/Escape, real filesystem draft-save rejection and idempotent retry, restart, complete backup/live missing-original restore and one explicit local model request. Native picker responses and a held restore acknowledgement at the main IPC boundary are isolated fixtures; external servers and physical picker interaction remain separate.

comparison.scope: Native two/four-model setup, duplicate exclusion/cancel, identical complete contexts/attachments/instructions over real HTTP, held streams, actual service failure and targeted stop, actual atomic-save EIO/retry, selected continuation and independent drafts, complete JSON/gzip export/restore, temporary persistence exclusion and normal restart, dark minimum-window zoom/keyboard and inert readonly previews. Native picker/confirmation responses are isolated fixtures; live external providers and physical system dialogs remain separate.
